summary_en: Final dividend per share raised from 150 yen to 170 yen for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026, reflecting upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings. Upward revision driven by stronger-than-expected performance in Asia wholesale business, particularly Indonesia subsidiary.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending December 2026 and Revision of Final Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
DAYTONA CORPORATION announced on November 6, 2026 that it is increasing its final dividend per share for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 from 150 yen to 170 yen, an increase of 20 yen. The company simultaneously revised upward its consolidated earnings forecast for the full year, with net income attributable to parent company shareholders now expected at 1,558 million yen, up 347 million yen or 28.7% from the previous forecast of 1,210 million yen.

The upward earnings revision reflects stronger-than-expected performance through the third quarter of fiscal 2026. The Asia wholesale business has outpaced the original plan, with the Indonesia subsidiary particularly strong due to expanded distribution channels and enriched product offerings. Domestic wholesale and retail operations have also performed solidly. Per-share earnings are now projected at 640.60 yen versus the prior forecast of 508.89 yen.

The company stated that it views profit returns to shareholders as a key management priority while maintaining financial soundness to invest in existing and new businesses for sustained growth. The dividend increase decision reflects this basic policy and the upward revision of consolidated earnings, taking into account the nature of earnings improvements, future investment plans, and the recovery status of past investments.
